question.text: Under Section 12A of the SEBI Act, which of the following activities is prohibited?

answer.text: Using manipulative or deceptive devices, employing schemes to defraud, engaging in fraud or deceitful conduct, insider trading, dealing in or communicating material non-public information, and acquiring control of a company in contravention of SEBI regulations
Only acquiring control of a company in contravention of SEBI regulations
Only using manipulative or deceptive devices in connection with the issue or sale of listed securities

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12A of the SEBI Act prohibits the use of manipulative or deceptive devices, employing schemes to defraud, engaging in fraud or deceitful conduct, insider trading, dealing in or communicating material non-public information, and acquiring control of a company in contravention of SEBI regulations. The Trap: Each "Only..." option lists one real Section 12A prohibition, but the section bans the full set together — picking just one prohibition understates the scope of Section 12A. Note: Section 12A is the primary anti-fraud and anti-insider-trading provision in the SEBI Act, and is read together with the PFUTP and Insider Trading Regulations for enforcement.
